corruption.description: Composite pressure mixing active incidents with logistics, trade, military, and governance risk at each tile.
corruption.label: Corruption Pressure

crisis.description: Normalized crisis pressure per tile derived from local grid stability and incidents.
crisis.label: Crisis Stress

culture.description: Local layer divergence relative to schism thresholds (1.0 = schism risk).
culture.label: Culture Divergence

elevation.description: Relative elevation above sea level after tectonic restamp (0 = coast, 1 = peaks).
elevation.label: Elevation Heatmap

fog.description: Knowledge gap for the controlling faction and local cohorts (1.0 = unknown, 0.0 = fully scouted).
fog.label: Fog of Knowledge

forage.description: The HUMAN-edible potential of this land — seeds, nuts, tubers, fruit, and fish. Every tile carries a value from its biome; forest and river valleys read rich where prairie reads poor, coastal shelves light up as fishing grounds, and only deep ocean, glacier and lava carry none.
forage.label: Forage (Human Food Capacity)

hunt_danger.description: How costly the wildlife on this tile is to HUNT — attack × ferocity, the deadliest fighter standing here. A placid grazer reads low even if huge; an aurochs or mammoth reads high. Empty ground reads as none.
hunt_danger.label: Hunt danger

logistics.description: Sum of supply flow touching the tile after current corruption multipliers.
logistics.label: Logistics Throughput

military.description: Composite of garrison morale, manpower, and local supply margin.
military.label: Force Readiness

moisture.description: Humidity field after windward lift and leeward drying (0 = arid, 1 = saturated).
moisture.label: Moisture & Rain Shadows

pasture.description: How much GRASS AND BROWSE this tile's biome can carry — the animal-edible stock (humans cannot digest it). Prairie is the reference pasture; a closed forest canopy shades the ground cover out; water, glacier and lava carry NO pasture at all and are drawn as barren, not as poor.
pasture.label: Pasture (Graze Capacity)

sentiment.description: Average morale of population cohorts anchored to the tile (fixed-point scale).
sentiment.label: Sentiment Morale

threat.description: How much the wildlife on this tile menaces you UNPROVOKED — attack × aggression. A grazer (aggression 0) reads none however dangerous it is to hunt; a predator reads high. Empty ground reads as none.
threat.label: Threat

visibility.description: Line-of-sight visibility from units and settlements (0 = unexplored, 0.5 = discovered, 1 = active).
visibility.label: Fog of War
